name: Shared OpenAPI Projection Validation
description: Align OA SDK and bun-graph-db validation around an OpenAPI 3.2 Projection Interface. Both systems keep their native source models, while a new contract package defines OpenApiProjectionResult, projection profiles, source/ref/diagnostic metadata, and a shared validation entrypoint.

userStories.title: Reconcile existing vocabulary draft and adapter tests
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the current draft vocabulary docs and adapter tests corrected before adding a package so that the new contract starts from a consistent baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: OA SDK adapter test maps registry diagnostics, target diagnostics, emit diagnostics, and validation diagnostics into the shared diagnostic envelope.
OA SDK adapter test includes at least one diagnostic case proving registry diagnostics survive mapping.
bun-graph-db shared boundary doc defines every type referenced in its vocabulary block, including SchemaTypeTarget or removes unused references.
OA SDK and bun-graph-db vocabulary docs use the same field names for projection, refs, diagnostics, sources, versionHash, and typeTargets.
Existing adapter tests remain thin field mappings and do not duplicate projection logic.
pnpm typecheck passes.
pnpm test or focused package tests pass.
bun run typecheck passes.
bun run lint --max-diagnostics=20 passes.
Focused bun-graph-db projection tests pass when projection/MCP behavior changes.
userStories.notes: Preflight story. Fix the review gaps in the current draft before creating the package.

userStories.title: Create OpenAPI projection contract package
userStories.description: As a schema platform maintainer, I want a shared contract package so that both systems can import the same projection result types without importing each other's source-specific code.
acceptanceCriteria: Add workspace package packages/openapi-projection-contract.
Package name is @oa-sdk/openapi-projection-contract.
Package exports OpenApiProjectionResult.
Package exports OpenApiProjectionProfile.
Package exports SchemaRefEdge, SchemaDiagnostic, SchemaSourceCoordinate, SchemaValidateResult, and SchemaTypeTarget.
Package has no dependency on OA SDK parser internals, codegen CLI internals, bun-graph-db repositories, MCP, GraphQL, REST, SQLite, or filesystem loading.
Package build script emits ESM and type declarations.
Contract package import smoke test passes from inside OA SDK workspace.
OA SDK API index is updated if public package exports are tracked there.
pnpm typecheck passes.
pnpm test or focused package tests pass.
pnpm build:scripts && pnpm check:api-index passes when public exports change.
userStories.notes: Keep this package contract-first and dependency-light. Do not move projection engines here.

userStories.title: Define projection profiles and semantics
userStories.description: As a validation tool author, I want projection profile semantics defined in code and docs so that validation can be profile-aware.
acceptanceCriteria: OpenApiProjectionProfile supports component-bundle, operation-contract, and full-api-document.
component-bundle permits empty paths and requires components.schemas.
operation-contract requires at least one operation under paths.
full-api-document requires normal OpenAPI document validation.
Contract docs explain which profile OA SDK and bun-graph-db should emit first.
Contract tests cover valid profile values and invalid profile values.
Profile semantics are not tied to one source model.
pnpm typecheck passes.
pnpm test or focused package tests pass.
pnpm build:scripts && pnpm check:api-index passes when public exports change.
userStories.notes: This story defines profile semantics before validator implementation.

userStories.title: Implement validateOpenApiProjection
userStories.description: As a validation user, I want a shared validateOpenApiProjection() entrypoint so that both systems can validate projection envelopes consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Contract package exports validateOpenApiProjection(result).
Validation checks OpenAPI document structural validity through a dependency-light path or a clearly documented injected validator.
Validation checks profile-specific requirements.
Validation checks refs entries have required from, ref, kind, and source.
Validation checks diagnostics entries have valid severity, code, and message.
Validation checks sources entries use supported file or DB coordinate variants.
Validation treats any diagnostic with severity error as projection-invalid.
Validation returns structured diagnostics and does not throw for ordinary invalid projection data.
Validation does not read files, query repositories, open SQLite, construct MCP servers, or execute GraphQL.
pnpm typecheck passes.
pnpm test or focused package tests pass.
pnpm build:scripts && pnpm check:api-index passes when public exports change.
userStories.notes: Prefer a small validator over a broad engine. Ordinary invalid inputs should return diagnostics.

userStories.title: Define projection metadata extensions
userStories.description: As a debugging user, I want standard OpenAPI extensions for projection metadata so that source and ref provenance can survive serialization.
acceptanceCriteria: Define extension names x-schema-engine-profile, x-schema-engine-version-hash, x-schema-engine-sources, and x-schema-engine-refs.
Contract package exports constants for these extension names.
Contract package documents which metadata belongs in standard OpenAPI fields versus x-* extensions.
Extension serialization preserves file source coordinates.
Extension serialization preserves DB source coordinates.
Extension serialization preserves ref graph metadata.
Extension fields do not invalidate OpenAPI document validation.
pnpm typecheck passes.
pnpm test or focused package tests pass.
pnpm build:scripts && pnpm check:api-index passes when public exports change.
userStories.notes: Define metadata names before adapters write extensions.

userStories.title: Add OA SDK Definition Builder projection adapter
userStories.description: As an OA SDK maintainer, I want Definition Builder output adapted to OpenApiProjectionResult so that OA SDK target builds can use the shared validation contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Add adapter from Definition Builder registry/selection/emit result to OpenApiProjectionResult.
Adapter sets profile to full-api-document.
Adapter maps emitted OpenAPI document to document.
Adapter maps registry ref edges to SchemaRefEdge.
Adapter includes registry, target, output naming, emit, and validation diagnostics.
Adapter maps file source paths, JSON Pointers, and line/column where available into file source coordinates.
Adapter computes or forwards a stable versionHash.
Adapter preserves alias/collision metadata through metadata or documented extension fields.
Tests cover successful document projection.
Tests cover registry diagnostics surviving adapter mapping.
pnpm typecheck passes.
pnpm test or focused package tests pass.
pnpm schema:validate passes when OpenAPI output changes.
pnpm build:scripts && pnpm check:api-index passes when public exports change.
userStories.notes: This adapter should live on the OA SDK side and must not import bun-graph-db code.

userStories.title: Validate OA SDK builder projections
userStories.description: As an OA SDK user, I want generated target documents to pass the shared projection validator so that builder outputs conform to the common validation interface.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing definition builder targets can be adapted to OpenApiProjectionResult.
validateOpenApiProjection() passes for public, admin, internal, and book-notebook targets.
Tests assert emitted target documents contain no oa:// refs.
Tests assert path parameters and operationIds are valid in emitted target documents.
Tests assert collision reports remain available.
Tests assert full-api-document profile rejects invalid emitted documents.
Focused test or CLI path verifies oa-gen build-spec output can be validated through the shared entrypoint.
pnpm typecheck passes.
pnpm test or focused package tests pass.
pnpm schema:validate passes when OpenAPI output changes.
pnpm build:scripts && pnpm check:api-index passes when public exports change.
userStories.notes: This story proves the OA SDK integration, not just the adapter unit test.

userStories.title: Wire bun-graph-db to the contract package
userStories.description: As a bun-graph-db maintainer, I want to consume the shared projection contract without importing OA SDK implementation internals so that bun adapters compile against the same types.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a local development dependency from bun-graph-db to @oa-sdk/openapi-projection-contract using the repository-relative path used in this workspace.
bun-graph-db imports only contract package types/helpers, not OA SDK parser/codegen internals.
bun-graph-db typecheck passes with the contract package dependency.
Document that the local file dependency is a development integration path until the package is published or vendored.
No bun-graph-db repository, GraphQL, MCP, or storage code is moved into the contract package.
bun run typecheck passes.
bun run lint --max-diagnostics=20 passes.
userStories.notes: This story resolves the cross-repo package boundary before bun adapters import the contract.

userStories.title: Add bun-graph-db component-bundle adapter
userStories.description: As a bun-graph-db maintainer, I want table schema projections adapted into OpenAPI 3.2 component bundles so that runtime DB metadata can use OpenAPI-compatible validation tooling.
acceptanceCriteria: Add adapter from TableSchemaProjection to OpenApiProjectionResult.
Adapter sets profile to component-bundle.
Adapter emits OpenAPI 3.2 document with openapi, info, empty paths, and components.schemas.
Adapter maps $defs entries into components.schemas.
Adapter rewrites internal $defs refs to #/components/schemas/...
Adapter preserves projection refs.
Adapter preserves projection diagnostics.
Adapter preserves DB source coordinates.
Adapter forwards versionHash.
Tests cover a valid table schema projection becoming a valid component-bundle projection.
Tests cover projection error diagnostics surviving adapter mapping.
bun run typecheck passes.
bun run lint --max-diagnostics=20 passes.
Focused bun-graph-db projection tests pass when projection/MCP behavior changes.
userStories.notes: First bun projection profile. Keep it independent from MCP schema generation for now.

userStories.title: Add bun-graph-db operation-contract adapter
userStories.description: As a bun-graph-db validation user, I want create/update node contracts represented as OpenAPI operations so that request payload validation can use the common OpenAPI projection interface.

Update node operation requestBody references projected update input schema.
Update node operation includes a required nodeId path parameter or equivalent operation parameter.
OperationIds are stable and table-specific.
Response stubs are valid OpenAPI responses.
Tests validate operation-contract output with validateOpenApiProjection().
Tests validate create payload success/failure through the shared validation path where supported.
Tests validate update payload partial semantics are preserved.

Focused bun-graph-db projection tests pass when projection/MCP behavior changes.

userStories.title: Align bun-graph-db MCP tools/list schema generation

Existing table-scoped tools remain listed.
